'''Shimmerstar Lake''' is situated in southern [[Moonwhisper Coast]]. On the islands is located [[Moro'gai Village]], home to the [[draenei]] of the [[Moro'gai tribe]].

==Trivia==
* The flight map refers to [[Moro'gai Village]]'s flight point as being Shimmerstar Lake.
